testcase.name: a torn tail costs the torn frame and nothing before it
every record written is replayed, in order
a floor pushes the next position past an applied watermark
replay resumes from a position, so an applied prefix is not applied twice
reopening the journal appends after the last valid frame
an orderly shutdown is distinguishable from a crash
frames written by earlier runs survive reopening
a flipped bit anywhere in a frame stops the replay there
frames left over from a previous run are not replayed as live data
